headline: Tiny Keys Break a Certificate Authority
lede: Eight intermediate certificates carried P-384 private keys small enough to recover in milliseconds. Browsers moved quickly to block them; command-line tools, embedded clients, and stale trust stores may not have.

headline: The 1.5-Degree Target Slips Away
lede: A new UNEP assessment says limiting warming to 1.5°C without a substantial overshoot is no longer viable. The remaining path demands steep emissions cuts, rapid electrification, and carbon removal at planetary scale.

headline: CSS Builds a Bigger Native Toolkit
lede: Interop 2027 gathers browser vendors around functions, anchor queries, scroll animations, and more. Progressive enhancement gets richer; JavaScript gets less work to do.

headline: PHP Warns of Two Critical Vulnerabilities
lede: PHP has announced an upcoming critical release for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. Until the official details and patch arrive, operators are weighing restrictions, downtime, and the cost of waiting.

headline: Why Fire Escapes Fell Out of Favor
lede: External fire escapes were once the cheapest answer to crowded, dangerous tenements. Better fire-rated construction, sprinklers, alarms, and interior stairs gradually made the familiar iron balcony a liability instead.

headline: A City Builder Turns Permits Into Gameplay
lede: This browser simulation makes housing, transit, industry, pollution, and neighborhood opposition collide on one planning screen. The build is intentionally simplified, but the trade-offs are not.

headline: Muse Shared Links Exposed Private Conversations
lede: Passive DNS records helped researchers enumerate roughly 6,800 Muse conversation links. The exposed material included business documents, financial details, and personal information; Meta paused the sharing feature while investigating.

headline: Complexity Is the Tax on Every Shortcut
lede: The Decoherence Trap argues that incompatible models accumulate until software becomes difficult to change, review, or even understand. AI-generated speed can enlarge that inheritance when feedback from the real world remains weak.
pullquote: More output does not mean more progress when the system can no longer stay coherent.

headline: Super Mario 64 Lands on a Tabletop
lede: Diorama64 turns each level into a miniature world for Apple Vision Pro. Move around the table, guide Mario with a gamepad, and watch a decompiled classic acquire a new physical scale.

headline: The Trust Chain Fails at Its Smallest Link
lede: Eight eMudhra intermediate CA keys were recoverable because flawed key generation produced trivially small private values. Revocation and browser blocks limit the immediate blast radius, but software libraries and embedded devices still depend on updated trust stores.
